text:
Hey, we’re in a very similar situation. So far, our apostilled marriage certificate plus proof that I’m legally single (not married to anyone else) has been enough. We've also registered our marriage in Israel before starting the process. 

I have British and Polish citizenship, but my wife and I got married in the US. We couldn’t register the marriage in the UK, and Poland still considers me single because they don’t recognise same sex marriages.

I think the single status documents and marriage certificate should be enough. If not, an affidavit explaining why you can’t obtain those documents might work too
